headline: Sensex rallies 700 points and Nifty tops 25,450 led by strong gains in auto stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex recovered strongly during the day, surging 700 points as Nifty crossed 25,450.
Nifty Auto sector soared 4% to lead the benchmark indices higher.
Nifty FMCG snapped its two-day losing streak, aiding market sentiment.
Markets initially opened flat to lower amid concerns over Federal Reserve rate hikes and IT sector selling.
whatHappening: Tata Technologies announced its strategic target to double its revenue by $1.3 billion by 2030.
Infosys led the decliners in early trade as IT and metal stocks faced selling pressure.
Maruti Suzuki and Bharat Electronics were among the top gainers during the trading session.
Razorpay is preparing to file for an IPO in India as early as next week.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices rebounded sharply after a cautious opening, with the Sensex surging 700 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,450.
The rally was primarily driven by a 4% surge in auto stocks along with a recovery in the FMCG sector.
Early weakness caused by US Fed rate hike concerns and IT sector selling was overcome as buying interest picked up in major gainers like Maruti Suzuki and Bharat Electronics.
